convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iBands, iAlligator). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale logic. Standard market orders with retry logic.

derived_values.name: Pip value - digit-adjusted price unit for SL/TP calculation
Sigma - tiny epsilon for floating point comparison

other_exits: Alligator-based close: BUY closed when Alligator Teeth line is rising (Teeth[1] > Teeth[2] + sigma), SELL closed when Alligator Teeth line is falling (Teeth[1] < Teeth[2] - sigma)
Session force close: positions closed at session end if sessionCloseAtFridayClose or sessionCloseAtSessionClose enabled
Trailing stop touches price: if trailing stop price equals current bid (buy) or ask (sell), position is closed instead of modified

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses Bollinger Bands: Long when price crosses below lower band (Open[0] < LowerBB[1] AND Open[1] > LowerBB[2]), Short when price crosses above upper band (Open[0] > UpperBB[1] AND Open[1] < UpperBB[2]). Exit uses Alligator Teeth (buffer index 1) direction: close BUY when Teeth rising, close SELL when Teeth falling. Trailing stop uses previous bar High/Low +/- SL pips. Filling type auto-fallback: FOK->IOC->RETURN on INVALID_FILL error. Entry only allowed when flat (posType==OP_FLAT). CopyBuffer indexing uses start_pos=1 with count=2, so index[1] is previous completed bar and index[0] is the bar before that.
python_conversion_notes: CopyBuffer with start_pos=1 count=2 returns array where [1]=bar-1 (most recently completed) and [0]=bar-2. Entry signal compares bar-1 and bar-2 Bollinger Band values against Open[0]=bar-1 and Open[1]=bar-2. The Alligator close checks Teeth line (buffer index 1) momentum between bar-1 and bar-2. Trailing stop for BUY: High[1] - SL*pip; for SELL: Low[1] + spread + SL*pip. Stop level must respect broker SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL. Pip value requires digit detection (4/5 digit=0.0001, 2/3 digit=0.01). Session filter currently set to 24h all week but logic is present for day-of-week and time restrictions.
